decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Grant planning permission for the following reason.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east side wall of the loft conversion hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - Two Conservation Area type roof which is flush fitting with the existing roof tiles shall be fitted to the front and rear elevation roof slopes at the positions herewith approved.
description: Conversion of roof space of top floor flat into two bedroom and a bathroom and installation of three windows to side elevation incorporating roof lights.
